subject: Re: Project Obsidian kickoff — Cluster-GCN on our entity graphs
body:
Anders,

Obsidian plan.

Staffing: Efe 50% (reproduction: PPI + Reddit, GraphSAGE-format preprocessing per the release); Csilla 40% (internal entity-graph adaptation — she knows the retrieval team's data model); Wei 30% (deep-GCN experiments once reproduction is green); Jorge 30% (infra: METIS builds, training pipeline).

Infra check done: metis-5.1.0 builds clean in our container with the shared-lib config, and Jorge verified the Python interface (part_graph on the example gives sane edgecuts). One gotcha — METIS_DLL has to be set in the job env or imports fail silently at runtime, he's baking it into the base image.

Compute: modest, that's the whole point of the method. 8 A100s best-effort on Titan covers everything including the internal graph.

Jelena
